lines.japanese: 「年越しに、ふたりで初詣に出かけようかって話してるんですよ」
lines.english: “We've discussed going together for our first shrine visit of the New Year.”

lines.japanese: 「日常を忘れてちょっと遠出なんかしたらロマンチックかなーって」
lines.english: “We thought a little trip away from ordinary life might be romantic.”

lines.japanese: 「初詣かあ。へぇー、どこ行くの？」
lines.english: “A shrine visit? Wow. Where are you going?”

lines.japanese: 「そっすねえ、ぼんやり考えてる感じだと、日和子さん古都とか好きそうだから、そっち方面でなにか本の舞台になったようなスポットがあれば」
lines.english: “Nothing definite yet. Hiyoko seems to like old capitals, so perhaps somewhere in that direction that served as the setting of a book.”

lines.japanese: 「おーし紀奈子さん、うちらもソコ行こうぜ」
lines.english: “All right, Kinako. Let's go there too.”

lines.japanese: 「行こー行こー！」
lines.english: “Let's go, let's go!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、あの、アナタ方が一緒じゃ、めちゃめちゃ変わらない日常なんですけど。『ふたりのロマンチック夢紀行』が、たちまち『千歳Ｐとゆく！　アレックス３のハチャメチャ珍道記』に落ちぶれちゃうんですけど」
lines.english: “Um, with you two along, it’d be business as usual. So much for getting away! *A Romantic Dream Journey for Two* would turn straight into *On the Road with Producer Chitose: The Alex Three’s Wacky Travels.*”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿おまえ、紀奈子さんは受験控えてるんだよ？　大切な初詣なんだから、古都とかそういうでっかいトコ行った方がいいだろ？」
lines.english: “Idiot, Kinako has entrance exams coming up. This is an important shrine visit, so shouldn't she go somewhere major, like an old capital?”

lines.japanese: 「えりちゃんありがとう、私のために……ううっ」
lines.english: “Eri, thank you for thinking of me... Sniff.”

lines.japanese: 「今年と同じ神社は避けないといけないもんね」
lines.english: “We have to avoid the same shrine as this year.”

lines.japanese: 「ねー、ほんとだよ！　柳木原神社、まったくご利益なかったよ！」
lines.english: “Seriously! Yanagihara Shrine didn't help at all!”

lines.japanese: 紀奈子さんは鞄の中からお守りを取りだすや、ぶいんぶいん振りまわしました。なんて罰当たりな。
lines.english: Kinako pulled an amulet from her bag and whipped it around. How sacrilegious.

lines.japanese: 「で、でも紀奈子さんは学業成就のお参りですよね。無理してうちらの目的地に合わせるより、ちゃんとソレ向きなトコへ行った方がいいと思いますよ？」
lines.english: “B-but you're praying for academic success. Instead of forcing your destination to match ours, shouldn't you visit a shrine suited to that?”

lines.japanese: 「アイツ、付きあい悪くなったね」
lines.english: “He's gotten antisocial.”

lines.japanese: 「カンジも悪くなったね」
lines.english: “And unpleasant.”

lines.japanese: 「っていうか紀奈子さん、遠くまでお参り行く時間あったら、受験勉強した方がよっぽど効果あるんじゃ」
lines.english: “Besides, if you have time to travel far for a shrine visit, studying for your exams would be much more effective.”

lines.japanese: 「しかも屁理屈こねるようになった」
lines.english: “And now he’s splitting hairs.”

lines.japanese: 「アレッ！？　フツーに正論ですよねえ！？」
lines.english: “What?! That was ordinary common sense!”

lines.japanese: 「──なーんてね。ま、千歳君なりにちゃんと考えてるならいいんだー」
lines.english: “—just kidding. If you've put real thought into it, fine.”

lines.japanese: 「さーて、あとは千歳君の愛を信じて帰るよ」
lines.english: “All right. Let's trust in Chitose's love and go home.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃーな。たまひよ泣かせんじゃねーぞ」
lines.english: “See you. Don't make Tama-chick cry.”

lines.japanese: 「はい。ご忠告はありがたくいただきました。」
lines.english: “Understood. I gratefully accept the warning.”

lines.japanese: そして紀奈子さんと英里子さんは店を出ていかれました。
lines.english: Then Kinako and Eriko left the restaurant.

lines.japanese: あらやだ、かわいい後輩をふたり残して先に帰っちゃうとは──
lines.english: My, my. Leaving two adorable juniors behind and going home first—

lines.japanese: ──なんて親切な先輩方なんでしょう。
lines.english: —what considerate senior coworkers they were.

lines.japanese: ふっと息を吹きあげて、前髪を揺らします。
lines.english: I puffed a breath upward and stirred my bangs.

lines.japanese: よし。
lines.english: All right.

lines.japanese: 「ぬるっと行こう！」
lines.english: “Let’s keep it slippery!”

lines.japanese: 足取りも軽く、階段を上っていきました。
lines.english: With a spring in my step, I climbed the stairs.
